projects.name: LUMO
projects.desc: AI search and research platform under active development. The repo documents keyword, semantic, hybrid, and AI-assisted search — not a finished product.
projects.long: LUMO is one of my main projects: an AI-powered search and research platform that is still under active development. The repository contains a FastAPI backend and a vanilla JavaScript frontend. Documented areas include keyword search, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, AI-assisted answers, source-oriented research workflows, a multi-provider AI router (Gemini, Grok, and Ollama), a knowledge graph, and a download-guardian area for URL and file checks. Those areas exist in the codebase as modules. They should be read as in-progress work, including experimental and planned research pieces, not as a production search engine.

projects.name: MYX AI
projects.desc: Development project for an AI-assisted Windows security assessment workspace. Not all parts are implemented or production-ready.
projects.long: MYX AI (Windows Edition) is a development project around authorized Windows security assessment and security analysis. The repository includes a React 19 and TypeScript frontend, a FastAPI and SQLAlchemy backend, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Gemini integration, and a Windows agent package. Documented pieces include website, network, and Wi-Fi assessment concepts, evidence-backed findings, CVSS v3.1 scoring, SSRF and private-network guards, cloud-metadata protection, URL checks, SPF and DMARC parsing, and RBAC tests. A status note in the repo separates completed, scaffolded, and runtime-dependent work. This is not a production security product.

projects.name: CodeDoctor AI
projects.desc: AI-assisted Python debugging with a complete-answer mode, a Socratic hint mode, and isolated execution.
projects.long: CodeDoctor AI is an AI-assisted coding and debugging project. It includes a React and TypeScript interface with Monaco Editor, a FastAPI backend, isolated Python execution with configurable timeouts, loop protection, memory limits, and standard-input support, plus code-health checks, anomaly detection, diagnosis history, and session restore. AI diagnosis has a complete-answer mode and a Socratic logic-hint mode, with Groq and a Gemini fallback.

projects.name: Multimodal Benchmark
projects.desc: Instrumented experiments for image understanding, speech, latency, and an STT-to-LLM-to-TTS pipeline.
projects.long: Multimodal Pipeline Benchmark measures vision, speech, and latency. It covers image-understanding experiments, image resolution and cost experiments, speech transcription, speech generation, and end-to-end voice workflows. Recorded measurements include image-token usage, estimated cost, chunked transcription latency, word error rate against a manual reference, and streaming TTS time-to-first-audio. It also compares sequential and concurrent STT-to-LLM-to-TTS pipelines and includes deterministic failure-handling demonstrations.

projects.name: DevAssist
projects.desc: Engineering-focused CLI LLM client with multi-turn chat, streaming, retries, and validated tool calls.
projects.long: DevAssist is a command-line LLM client. The published client uses the OpenAI API, with multi-turn conversation history, a stateless request demonstration, streamed responses, token and cost reporting, context trimming, retries on 429 and 5xx responses, JSON-schema invoice extraction, and a validated calculator tool call. Built with Python and Pydantic.

projects.name: API Client
projects.desc: Reusable REST client with session reuse, retries, structured logging, and generator-based pagination.
projects.long: Production-Grade API Client is a reusable Python REST client. It reuses a requests session, retries 429 and 5xx responses with exponential backoff and jitter, honors Retry-After, logs in a structured form, validates environment configuration, fails fast on other 4xx responses, and paginates with a generator. Dependencies include Requests and python-dotenv.
